summary.en: Picked rows leave a panel on an upward arc, staggered, change into cards on the way and land on the canvas; their slots stay as dashed outlines.
summary.zh: 选中的行错峰沿上弧离开面板，途中变成卡片落到画布上，原位留下虚线空槽。

fits: Items moving from a list into a workspace: picks placed on a board, results added to a canvas.
notFor: Re-ordering in place (layout-morph); more than about six items; copies.

intent.en: The same items change form on the way from a list to a canvas, so the viewer reads them as moved and materialised, not deleted and re-added.
intent.zh: 同一批条目从列表飞到画布、途中变了形态，观众读到的是“它飞过去变的”，不是删掉一个再加一个。

content.en: A panel of rows and an open canvas; 2–6 items, each with a row form (≤ 30 chars) and a card form (title ≤ 20 chars, a line or two).
content.zh: 一个由行组成的面板和一块空画布；2–6 个条目，各有行形态（≤ 14 字）和卡形态（标题 ≤ 8 字，一两行正文）。

fits.zh: 条目从列表进入工作区：选中的项放上看板、生成结果落到画布、一次选择变成实体。

notFor.zh: 原地重排（用 layout-morph）；一次超过约六项；复制（虚线空槽说的是“移走了”）。

pairs.note: the pointer ticks the rows and presses the button before they fly

en: The slot a row leaves must stay as a dashed outline; if the panel looks untouched, the move reads as a copy.
Never show the row and the card content at once on the way: one fades out before the other fades in.
zh: 行飞走后原位必须留下虚线空槽；面板完好如初，“迁移”就成了“复制”。
途中行内容和卡内容不能同时出现：一个淡完另一个才亮。

upstream.name: 行倒卡上画布
upstream.summary: 复选框逐个自动打勾→按钮按下→三行沿上抛弧线错峰飞出，途中行形态与卡形态交叉淡化，落位带随机倾角；面板行槽塌陷成虚线留白
upstream.use: AI/协作工具"生成结果落到画布上"的叙事段落；A 式讲"已有内容换了个存在形态"，B 式讲"从一句话长出一棵结构"

overlaps.note: tiles re-laid out in one container; row-to-card moves objects between containers and changes their form
